name: japanese_news
market: Japan, national newspaper with 50+ years of history
density: Extremely information-dense but visually organized. Every inch is used. A 5-column grid of news items above the fold with thumbnail images. Category tabs across the top with 20+ news sections. Right sidebar has weather, stocks, sports scores, and TV schedule. The density feels intentional and readable, unlike chaos — Japanese typographic discipline creates order within extreme density.
nav_style: Thin top bar with date, weather, and login. Below it the newspaper masthead in Japanese with English subtitle. Below that a horizontal category scrollbar with 20+ categories: Politics, Economy, International, Sports, Culture, Entertainment, Science, Life, Regional, Opinion. Each has sub-tabs on click.
commercial_model: Ad-supported premium news. Banner ads appear in fixed slots — top leaderboard, right sidebar, and interstitial between article sections. Premium subscriber badge shown for logged-in users.
color_palette: Dark red (#CC0000) newspaper masthead. Black (#000000) text on white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds. Very light grey (#F7F7F7) for sidebar and footer backgrounds. Blue (#0066CC) for links. No decorative colors — pure news utility palette.
typography: Japanese news typography: Noto Serif JP for headlines, Noto Sans JP for body text. Body at 14px, tightly leaded. Headlines at 18-22px. Japanese text uses full-width characters. English loan words in katakana alongside translated content.

pages.title: Top Page
pages.description: 5-column breaking news grid, top stories carousel, category quick-links, stock ticker widget, weather, sports scores, ad placements

pages.title: Politics
pages.description: National politics section with Diet session news, party news, election coverage, political opinion columns

pages.title: Economy & Business
pages.description: Economic news, corporate earnings, market data table, business features, real estate market section

pages.title: International
pages.description: World news by region (Asia, Americas, Europe, Middle East), foreign correspondent dispatches, international opinion

pages.title: Culture & Life
pages.description: Arts, entertainment, food, travel, lifestyle. Review sections for film, music, books. Event calendar.
